crows.note: a=t*spd*it[0]*2pi+it[1]; x=cx-camX*k+cos(a)*rx*it[2]+it[3]; y=cy+sin(a)*ry*it[4]+it[5]; facing=sign(-sin a); flap=(0,1,2,1)[floor((t+i*0.23)*10)%4]

mist.note: x=(x0+t*v)%(W+L)-L; fillRect(x, y, L+1, 2) (PIL rect y..y+1)

ripples.note: x=px-camX; per puddle k=0,1: a=t*5+k*0.5; age=a%1; if age<0.8: rx=x+rand(int(px),floor(a))*pw*0.6-pw*0.3; rw=1+6age; ellipse outline [rx-rw, py-0.3rw, rx+rw, py+0.3rw]

lightning.note: flash=seq[min(5,floor((t-t0)*15))] for 0<=t-t0<0.4; after clouds draw sky_bright at alpha 0.75*flash; if bolt and flash>0.45 draw bolt (BEHIND far/mid/near); after the street+puddles fillRect(0,90,W,126) rgb(190,200,230) alpha 0.18*flash

layers.note: dash [dy,L,spd,ph,x0,bs,par]: x=(x0+t*spd-camX*par)%(W+40)-20; b=sin(t*bs+ph); b>0.1: line(x,y+dy)-(x+L,y+dy) col=hi if b>0.55 else mid; b<-0.6: col=lo. reflection: for k<h/2: yy=y+3+2k (<y+h); half=1+int(0.35k)+int(|sin(3t+k)|*2); if sin(4t+1.7k)>-0.4: xo=int(sin(2t+k)*1.5); line(rx-half+xo,yy)-(rx+half+xo,yy) col=refl

ships.note: x=(i*157+t*spd-camX*par)%(W+240)-120 (centre); y=y+sin(0.9t+i)*2; far ones drawn before the terminal, the rest after far_city; lights blink (not baked)

layers.note: y = dy - 40, dy = lerp(-34, 8, ease_in_out((t-13.5)/2.9)) (city sinks as the ship rises)

dash [dy,L,spd,ph,x0,bs,par]: x=(x0+t*spd-camX*par)%(W+40)-20; b=sin(t*bs+ph); b>0.1: line(x,y+dy)-(x+L,y+dy) col=hi if b>0.55 else mid; b<-0.6: col=lo. reflection: for k<h/2: yy=y+3+2k (<y+h); half=1+int(0.35k)+int(|sin(3t+k)|*2); if sin(4t+1.7k)>-0.4: xo=int(sin(2t+k)*1.5); line(rx-half+xo,yy)-(rx+half+xo,yy) col=refl

ship.note: draw_ship(x,y): x0=round(x-w/2), y0=round(y-h*0.62); pole line (x0+6,y0+39)-(x0+6,y0+63) INK; flag22 frames at (x0+5-24+1, y0+41-4) 10fps; thrusters at x0+tx,y0+ty

ship_silhouette.note: key = round(scale*40); centred at the ship position

kamui_sil.note: screen-space (after zoom): x = 344 + int(wave(t,0.2,2.0)) - int(10u) - ax*4, y = 104 - (ay-26)*4 (ax/ay = anchor in the uncropped sprite; here relative to crop)
